mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_tax_document_sequence (id, issuer_party_id, registration_id, series_code, document_kind, next_number, number_format, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.issuerPartyId}, #{row.registrationId}, #{row.seriesCode}, #{row.documentKind}, #{row.nextNumber}, #{row.numberFormat}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
mapper.select: SELECT id, issuer_party_id, registration_id, series_code, document_kind, next_number, number_format, create_time, update_time FROM t_tax_document_sequence WHERE issuer_party_id = #{issuerPartyId} AND registration_id = #{registrationId} AND series_code = #{seriesCode} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_tax_document_sequence SET next_number = next_number + 1, update_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND next_number = #{expected}
